passage.text: This is a weather warning for Bangkok.
passage.reading: ðɪs ɪz ə ˈwɛðər ˈwɔːrnɪŋ fər ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: There will be heavy rain on Saturday and Sunday.
passage.reading: ðɛr wɪl bi ˌhɛvi ˈreɪn ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ ənd ˈsʌndeɪ.

passage.text: Some streets might flood, and there may be storms with thunder.
passage.reading: sʌm ˈstriːts maɪt ˈflʌd, ənd ðɛr meɪ bi ˈstɔːrmz wɪð ˈθʌndər.

passage.text: Please stay indoors on Saturday night.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈsteɪ ˌɪnˈdɔːrz ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: If you have to go out, take the train, not your car.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ˈhæf tə ˈɡoʊ ˈaʊt, ˈteɪk ðə ˈtreɪn, ˈnɑːt jʊr ˈkɑːr.

passage.text: The rain will probably stop on Monday morning.
passage.reading: ðə ˈreɪn wɪl ˈprɑːbəbli ˈstɑːp ɑːn ˈmʌndeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

passage.text: Please watch the weather forecast on TV.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈwɑːtʃ ðə ˈwɛðər ˈfɔːrkæst ɑːn ˌtiːˈviː.
